decisions.decision: WanGP (deepbeepmeep/Wan2GP) is the engine, NOT ComfyUI
decisions.why: ComfyUI has no reliable headless batch path and the 3 audited ComfyUI projects are demo-grade with deadlocks. WanGP ships a documented in-process Python API, a CLI queue mode, and an MCP server.

decisions.decision: ComfyUI is out of the production path entirely
decisions.why: Its /history endpoint only returns completed prompts, so running-vs-queued is indistinguishable, and it discards node error payloads.
14B A14B needs two 14B transformers (~30GB of weights) and does not fit a 4090 without heavy offload.

decisions.decision: Hybrid output: most shots are still art with camera motion, real generated video for the beats that matter
decisions.why: This is what the reference channels actually do (their hashtag is #MotionComic). Full generation for every second costs 80-160 GPU-hours per 2-hour film.
SaladCloud containers are stateless and unprivileged: no volume mounts, no persistent disk. R2 has no egress fees and the nodes are global.
A single generation tops out at 121 frames. Longer narration is split and chained, which also makes each piece separately retriable.

decisions.decision: seeds derived from content, never randomised
decisions.why: Two audited repos add a timestamp to the seed, which destroys reproducibility and makes A/B testing impossible.

brief_corrections: Source D in BRIEF.md (pythongosssss/Wan2GP) no longer exists. The live repo is deepbeepmeep/Wan2GP, 9,643 stars. All analysis was redone against it.

BRIEF.md asks for 'Persistent Storage' on SaladCloud. That does not exist. Container filesystems are ephemeral and volume mounting is explicitly unsupported because containers are unprivileged. R2 is the replacement.
eg250k-del/openclude was an EMPTY repository (GitHub returns 409 Conflict). There is no prior code to continue from.
BRIEF.md says WSL2 hides part of the VRAM, so a 24GB 4090 is really ~22GB usable. Plan against 22GB, not 24.
The Colab notebook (source E) uses --profile 5, which is a T4/15GB setting and is wrong for a 4090. The engine's own docker script uses --profile 3 for 24GB.
The Colab notebook sets WAN_CACHE_DIR, which no code in the engine reads. It is a fictional environment variable.
BRIEF.md implies one Wan 2.2 model. There are two viable tiers and they differ in cost by 3x. Both are listed in demo_full.py.
known_gaps: No GPU has run this. The image built, but nothing has been submitted to SaladCloud yet.
The worker's deps_writer() and deps_synth() still return the 'not implemented' stubs. The real clients exist in llm_client.py and tts_client.py and just need wiring.
No SaladCloud credentials are configured, so apply has never run. min_replicas is 0, so a deployed idle group costs nothing.
Object storage is not configured. The container refuses to start without S3_*, by design.
ffmpeg is absent on the dev machine, so 4 integration tests skip. The guard rails around it are tested by stubbing the probe.
S3Store has never touched a live bucket.
Degradation state is not persisted across restarts; each restart re-discovers it by failing once.
No character-sheet image generation yet. The Character.views field is shaped for it.
No lip sync. The engine supports it (MultiTalk, FantasyTalking) but the Shot schema has no field for it.
